arxiv-2103-03164.title: Realizing Majorana fermion modes in the Kitaev model
arxiv-2103-03164.creator: Lu Yang 1, Jia-Xing Zhang 1, Shuang Liang 3, Wei Chen 1,2, Qiang-Hua Wang 1,2
arxiv-2103-03164.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Lu Yang 1, Jia-Xing Zhang 1, Shuang Liang 3, Wei Chen 1,2, Qiang-Hua Wang 1,2. We study the possibility to realize Majorana zero mode that’s robust and may be easily manipulated for braiding in quantum computing in the ground state of the Kitaev model in this work. To achieve this we first apply a uniform [ 111 ] [111] magnetic field to the gapless Kitaev model and turn the Kitaev model to an effective p + i ​ p p+ip topological superconductor of spinons.

arxiv-2106-00098.title: Local variants of the Dixmier property and weak centrality for C*-algebras
arxiv-2106-00098.creator: Robert J. Archbold, Ilja Gogić, Leonel Robert
arxiv-2106-00098.description: Abstract . We study variants of the Dixmier property that apply to elements of a unital C*-algebra, rather than to the C*-algebra itself. By a Dixmier element in a C*-algebra we understand one that can be averaged into a central element by means of a sequence of unitary mixing operators. Examples include all self-commutators and all quasinilpotent elements.

arxiv-2110-10692.title: Emergent anomalies and generalized Luttinger theorems in metals and semimetals
arxiv-2110-10692.creator: Chong Wang, Alexander Hickey, Xuzhe Ying, A.A. Burkov
arxiv-2110-10692.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Chong Wang, Alexander Hickey, Xuzhe Ying, A.A. Burkov. Luttinger’s theorem connects a basic microscopic property of a given metallic crystalline material, the number of electrons per unit cell, to the volume, enclosed by its Fermi surface, which defines its low-energy observable properties. Such statements are valuable since, in general, deducing a low-energy description from microscopics, which may perhaps be regarded as the main problem of condensed matter theory, is far from easy.

arxiv-2409-10237.title: Directed equality with dinaturality Thanks: Loregian was supported by the Estonian Research Council grant PRG1210. Veltri was supported by the Estonian Research Council grant PSG749.
arxiv-2409-10237.creator: Andrea Laretto and Fosco Loregian and Niccolò Veltri
arxiv-2409-10237.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Andrea Laretto and Fosco Loregian and Niccolò Veltri. We show how dinaturality plays a central role in the interpretation of directed type theory where types are interpreted as (1-)categories and directed equality is represented by hom \hom -functors. We present a general elimination principle based on dinaturality for directed equality which very closely resembles the J J -rule used in Martin-Löf type theory, and we highlight which syntactical restrictions are needed to interpret this rule in the context of directed equality.

arxiv-2506-02539.title: VerificAgent : Integrating Expert Knowledge and Fact-Checked Memory for Robust Domain-Specific Task Planning
arxiv-2506-02539.creator: Thong Q. Nguyen, Shubhang Desai, Yash Jain, Tanvir Aumi, Vishal Chowdhary
arxiv-2506-02539.description: Abstract Continual memory augmentation allows computer-use agents (CUAs) to learn from past interactions and refine their task-solving strategies over time. However, unchecked memory accumulation can introduce spurious or hallucinated “learnings” that degrade agent performance—particularly in domain-specific workflows such as productivity software.

pmc-11355774.creator: Hyunwook Shin, Hyeonjun Woo, Yunhee Han, Seungkwan Choi, Jungho Jo, Seojae Jeon, Wonbae Ha, Junghan Lee
pmc-11355774.description: Background: This study aimed to summarize the current status of research on ultrasound-guided acupuncture and dry-needling treatment and the specific treatment methods applied to patients. Methods: A scoping review was conducted, surveying three English databases (PubMed, Embase, and the Cochrane Library) for studies published up to May 2024. All studies related to ultrasound-guided acupuncture and dry-needling treatment were considered.

pmc-13248979.creator: Beata Skonieczna, Bartosz Maliszewski, Natalia Wasiluk, Halina Car, Agnieszka Z Wilczewska, Paweł Misiak, Katarzyna Niemirowicz-Laskowska
pmc-13248979.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundThe objective of this study is to evaluate the biological activity of cholesterol-modified cyclodextrin (CD21chol) complexes with 5-fluorouracil (5-FU) prepared at different molar ratios (1:1, 1:2, and 1:3) and to identify the most potent anticancer formulation.MethodsThe inclusion complexes of CD21chol:5-FU were prepared at different molar ratios (1:1, 1:2, and 1:3) and initially characterized based on their physicochemical properties, such as increased negative surface charge and particle size.

pmc-13556421.title: 759. Addressing Clinical Trial Heterogeneity in Neuropsychiatric Long COVID Research: A Registry-Based Cross-Sectional Analysis of Pharmacotherapeutic Intervention Trial Designs
pmc-13556421.creator: N Hartman, D Ivkic, M C Dorczok, I Bozic, L Reinfried, A-C Moser, G Fugger, B Ludwig, F Buchmayer, M Spies, A Weidenauer, L Bartova, COVIKET Study Group
pmc-13556421.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundLong COVID (LC) poses a considerable clinical and socioeconomic burden on affected patients and their surroundings (1-3). LC presents with diverse symptom clusters (4). One of the most prevalent is the neuropsychiatric symptom cluster. Symptoms related to this cluster are chronic fatigue, cognitive dysfunctions, symptoms related to depression and anxiety including sleep disturbances, inner tension, pain, hypersensitivity to acoustic and visual stimuli, as well as vegetative dysautonomia (5).

pmc-13578375.creator: Helena Herm, Thomas Borgmann, Manfred Berger, Hendrik-Johannes Pels
pmc-13578375.description: Calcified amorphous tumors (CAT), also known as toothpaste tumors, are associated with a high prevalence of cerebrovascular events. Present literature provides limited information on conservative treatment strategies, as most published cases had undergone surgical treatment. Hence, this report demonstrates a conservative treatment of right middle cerebral artery syndrome in a 76-year-old woman due to a CAT.

uslaw-usc-t10-s2241a.title: 10 U.S.C. § 2241a — Prohibition on use of funds for publicity or propaganda purposes within the United States
uslaw-usc-t10-s2241a.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s2241a.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part IV (Service, Supply, And Property); Chapter 134 (Miscellaneous Administrative Provisions); Subchapter I (Miscellaneous Authorities, Prohibitions, And Limitations On The Use Of Appropriated Funds). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Funds available to the Department of Defense may not be obligated or expended for publicity or propaganda purposes within the United States not otherwise specifically authorized.
